gloss_en: "From the wing (edge/corner) of the earth" (mi-kenaf ha-aretz) — the phrase from Isaiah 24:16, "from the wing of the earth we have heard songs," where kenaf denotes the earth's extremity/corner (associated with the four wings/corners and, in Likutey Moharan, with Metatron and the lower unification); not kanaf as a bird's literal wing or garment-corner in another verse
